HexKagune 1.3.4 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (protocol 57). Testing build: pushed without a local build, not tried in game.

- Eto fights with the Owl DNA kit now, the same moves a Pale player throws, with the same timings, the same animations (the player's own animator drives her body) and the same impact effects. No more Ukaku shards.
- Speed Blitz: the full eight-strike string (jab, cross, hook, liver shot, uppercut, the blink palm from the side, the spinning backfist, the twin palm finisher after a blink to the front), stepping in from just out of reach.
- Big Punch: she sinks into the wind-up, lets it go, blinks in front of you and drives it through, launching you. At the full charge, if it lands, it goes into Witness This: behind you, the uppercut, the storm of blows all over the sky, the stomp down into the ground with a shockwave.
- Speed Kick: the lunge, gone (untouchable), there, the leg through your middle and you launched far away, tumbling; she rebounds over backwards.
- Flips in over a gap and back clear, as before.
- She uses them far more: the kick whenever it's ready once she's serious, the Big Punch at full charge most of the time when serious and always when maniac, and much shorter cooldowns as she gets hurt.
- Holding hands: she stays glued to your side and walks as one with you (facing your way), and your hands meet instead of reaching past each other.
- Talk screen: the answers sit in the middle of the space under her line instead of down at the edge of the board.
- Speed Kick and Witness This keep her moving every tick, so she's now synced to clients every tick (smoother on screen).
